Deck Name : Muricia's Mighty Morphin Minions Multiply
Author : Norman S. Brown Jr
Description :
It is a weenie deck where all your presence weenies clan impersonate
to Gangrel Antitribu to take advantage of Muricia's special. Remember
that Clan Impersonation overides Muricia's ability so they all stay as
Gangrel Antitribu, so you can use Muricia's ability repeatedly on a
Clan impersonated Gangrel Antitribu to give them superior Spiritus

Crypt [12 vampires] Capacity min: 2 max: 7 average: 3.84
------------------------------------------------------------

3x Muricia 7 ANI PRE SPI Ahrimane:4
1x Aiyana, The Wolfca 3 pre spi Ahrimane:4
1x Diana Vick 3 dom pre Ventrue:3
1x Jonathan Gursel 3 aus pre !Toreador:4
1x Mazz 3 cel pre Brujah:3
1x Panya, The Wicked 3 cel pre Ishtarri:4
1x Reverend Djoser Jo 3 pre ser Follower :4
1x Smash 3 pot pre !Brujah:4
1x Emerson Wilkershir 2 pre Toreador:3
1x Justine Chen, Inno 2 pre !Toreador:4

Library [90 cards]
------------------------------------------------------------

Action [23]
8x Clan Impersonation
7x Legal Manipulations
8x Vulture's Buffet

Action Modifier [12]
6x Bewitching Oration
6x Squirrel Balance

Combat [15]
8x Chameleon's Colors
7x Majesty

Combat/Action Modifier [6]
6x Swiftness of the Stag

Master [16]
4x Effective Management
7x Presence
1x Regent
3x Specialization
1x Spontaneous Power

Political Action [10]
1x Cardinal Benediction
9x Kine Resources Contested

Retainer [8]
8x D'habi Revenant

Crafted with : Anarch Revolt Deck Builder. [Thu May 31 13:18:45 2007]

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

> Political Action [10]
> 1x Cardinal Benediction
> 9x Kine Resources Contested

I think this deck would be better losing the Vote angle and just going
for dedicated bleed. Without vote push you're relying on the table
allowing your votes to succeed which will more often than not result
in damage hitting where you don't want it to.

Removing the vote angle, you would have 16 cards to make into better
choices. Some Aires, more Legal Manips, Entrancements, Speak with
Spirits etc.

I also think that the 8x Chameleon's Colors could be better cards
considering it is only useable at long range.

Messages.Author: demonturtle
Messages.Body:
I am always leery of decks that start with, "So, my vampire Clan
Impersonates. . . ," especially when you are functionally doing two of
them to get each vampire into the right state of being :-). I like
the way you are trying to use Muricia and Spiritus, but I would agree
with other commentators that without a lot of vote push you could end
up wasting your political actions when you could be bleeding your prey
with more Legals or Aires at decent stealth. You could even toss in a
few Marijava Ghouls for extra stealth on the Legals.

The pool gain tech is neat, but I don't see any Blood Dolls, or other
methods for getting blood on your vamps. A lot of your actions cost
blood and there is no way other than hunting to get some back. Maybe
a couple of Engling Furys? You could also drop the Regent, an
Effective, and a Presence and get three Blood Dolls, which gives you
tactical flexibility with your pool.

I look forward to hearing how the deck works.

Cheers,

John

>
> Both Muricia and clan impersonation are cards in play. Whichever card
> generates the last effect would take precedence one would think.

Muricia's being in play doesn't cloak the vampire's clan.
That's not an effect of her being in play.

Her special allows the ability to take make some activity. The activity's effect
(at resolution, not from card-in-play) is what changes the clan.

If she leaves play, the vampires that used her special would still receive the
benefit of that change.
